g.text: STREAMMUSE / RESEARCH BRIEF / GROUP GUIDE / G5

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 25px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #202735

g.text: G5 How does server speech become playable audio?

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #566171

g.text: Formal name: delivery. Downstream means the steps after the stage currently being measured.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #566171

g.text: VARIABLE / UNIT

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #566171

g.text: PLAIN-LANGUAGE MEANING

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52778d

g.text: WHAT WE DERIVE OR CHECK

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52778d

g.text: Route

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #566171

g.text: network path / host placement
Where audio bytes travel. Here: server on H200 to
Mac through an SSH-forwarded connection.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52778d

g.text: Codec / format

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #566171

g.text: PCM or Opus
PCM stores sample values directly; Opus compresses
audio. Format can affect size, decoding and quality.

tspan.style: font-style: oblique; font-size: 12.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52778d
font-style: oblique; font-size: 8.68px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52778d

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #566171

g.text: bytes
Size of the audio package and metadata transferred
for output j. Metadata describes the audio and timing.

tspan.style: font-style: oblique; font-size: 12.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52778d
font-style: oblique; font-size: 8.68px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52778d

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #566171

g.text: ms duration
Time for the named transfer step, not the whole wait
from asking for a lyric until its audio arrives.

tspan.style: font-style: oblique; font-size: 12.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52778d
font-style: oblique; font-size: 8.68px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52778d

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #566171

g.text: ms duration
Mac time to decode, fit speech to the flow, add drums
and mix. Prepared means locally playable.

tspan.style: font-style: oblique; font-size: 12.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52778d
font-style: oblique; font-size: 8.68px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52778d
font-style: oblique; font-size: 8.68px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52778d
font-style: oblique; font-size: 8.68px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52778d
font-style: oblique; font-size: 8.68px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52778d

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #566171

g.text: ms duration
Time left after preparation for freezing, enqueueing
and device delivery. Sink means audio output device.

tspan.style: font-style: oblique; font-size: 12.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52778d
font-style: oblique; font-size: 8.68px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52778d

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #566171

g.text: sample frames per second
Converts time to a position in digital audio.
At 48,000 frames/s, one frame is about 0.021 ms.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52778d

g.text: Source onsets / target slots

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #566171

g.text: source seconds / musical positions
Onset: estimated syllable start in ordinary speech.
Target slot: where that syllable should start in the flow.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52778d

g.text: Server-ready vs received
Audio may exist on H200 before its bytes
reach the Mac. Measure both boundaries.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52778d

g.text: Received vs prepared
Received audio still needs local work.
Preparation adds a separate duration.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52778d

g.text: Prepared vs heard
Queued frames still pass through a device.
Acoustic timing requires measurement.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52778d

g.text: WHY ONE GROUP?
These variables describe the remaining path after server speech generation. They are part of total
work in G2, not extra costs to count twice; G1 reserves time for whichever of these steps remain.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52778d

g.text: NAMES USED IN THE SYSTEM DIAGRAM
MOSS: neural speech generator.
MMS: estimates speech-to-text alignment.
R3: Rubber Band pitch-preserving stretch.
eSpeak: local robotic speech fallback.
SSH: encrypted network connection.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52778d

g.text: EXAMPLE
Receive at 2.000 s + prepare for 50 ms
= prepared at 2.050 s, not yet heard.
